title: Baross Gábor and the Zone Tariff: Degree Adverbs
grammar: Degree adverbs for the size of an effect
goal: I can say how big the effect of a reform was with a degree adverb (*számottevően*, *jelentősen*, *alapjaiban*).
I can say what the text about the zone tariff of 1889 tells.
I can name the ideas of the reform (*zónatarifa-rendszer*, *vasútállamosítás*, *egységes díjszabás*).
